title: GeneExprLupusMx: transcriptómica de lupus en mujeres mexicanas para investigación y enseñanza
text: goal GeneExprLupusMx provide bilingual, reproducible R data package integrates transcriptomic profiles clinical metadata Mexican women systemic lupus erythematosus healthy controls. combining gene expression data monocytes, monocyte-derived dendritic cells (moDCs), tolerogenic dendritic cells (tolDCs), package enables: Educational use: serving teaching resource bioinformatics, immunology, biomedical sciences. Comparative analysis: supporting exploration gene regulation networks differential expression studies. **Reproducible workflows:*+ offering auxiliary functions scripts replicate figures analyses original study. Global integration: making locally generated datasets visible usable international research contexts. Scientific outreach: promoting open science dissemination biomedical data Latin America.

title: Cleaned metadata with patient and cell type annotations — metadata_cleaned
Cleaned metadata with patient and cell type annotations — metadata_cleaned
text: data frame multiple rows (samples) 13 columns: sample_ID Unique identifier sample. Group Disease group (e.g., SLE patient control). GC Glucocorticoid treatment status. Dose Numeric dose treatment. Dose_category Categorical dose classification. Age Age patient. Cell_type Annotated cell type (mo, moDC, tolDC). Group_age Combined group age category. Nephritis Presence nephritis (yes/). Other_tx treatments received. Sledai_score SLEDAI disease activity score. Sledai_group Grouped SLEDAI classification. SLEDAI_Md Median SLEDAI score. SLEDAI_category Categorical SLEDAI classification.
